{{Quote|We are receiving a message from the Chancellor's office, sir.''"<br />"''Send it through.''"<br />"''Yes, sir.|Jeremoch Colton and Bail Organa|audio=Colton-Organa.flac|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Jeremoch Colton''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and had a long record of service in the [[House of Organa/Legends|Royal House of Alderaan]]. He wore the same uniform as the rest of the ''Sundered Heart'' crew, and he had blond hair and blue eyes. He is not to be confused with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]], who had overall command of the ''Sundered Heart'' and considered Colton to be his mentor.<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

==Biography==
Colton had a long career as a pilot of the [[House of Organa/Legends|Royal House of Alderaan]]. Prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV/Legends|Star of Alderaan]]'', later known as the ''Tantive IV,'' was commissioned under his command.<ref name="REF">{{InsiderCite|90|Refresher Reading}}</ref> At the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] on board the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']] during its return to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] rescued [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].

Colton was among the crew aboard the ''Sundered Heart'' when Bail Organa, Yoda, and Obi-Wan Kenobi went on the search for surviving [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. He answered the call of [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] when Bail Organa's presence in the Senate was asked by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Having learned the tricks of the trade, Colton planned to retire from active service and decided to teach at the [[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]] until it was destroyed [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="EAWGG" /> Presumably Colton was among the victims of Alderaan's destruction.<ref name="Galactic Files" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jeremoch Colton was played by [[Jeremy Bulloch]], the same actor who portrayed [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in the [[original trilogy]]. "Jeremoch" is an obvious portmanteau of his name.

The name Colton Antilles is given for Raymus Antilles in some sources, leading some fans to believe that the Captain Antilles in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] is a separate character named Colton Antilles, possibly named after the Captain Colton in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]. However, [[Leland Chee]] has confirmed that both Captains Antilles are meant to be the same person.<ref name="SWBoards 1">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=1395#13928375|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-01-25|time=5:41 PM}}</ref><ref name="SWBoards 2">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=1185#13440451|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2005-11-28|time=10:46 AM}}</ref>
